players.product: biosimulation, regulatory science, and AI-assisted drug-development software

quarterly_data.signal: Certara serves more than 2,600 customers in over 70 countries with nearly 160,000 daily software users. Every one of the 13 novel therapies approved by FDA in the quarter came from a Certara client; 30 Phoenix cloud implementations were won year to date.
quarterly_data.figure: >2,600 customers; >70 countries; ~160,000 daily users; 30 Phoenix cloud implementations

quarterly_data.signal: AI now assists up to 85% of new code and software-engineering development rate increased 65% year over year. Internal agents cut selected legal and IT cycle times by as much as 90%; scientific agent workflows accelerated selected service tasks by up to 80%.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 85% AI-assisted code; development rate +65%; cycle time -90%; service tasks up to 80% faster

quarterly_data.signal: CoAuthor has supported more than 400 regulatory submissions and now provides nearly 600 AI agents; management reported a 40% increase in document-drafting quality-control productivity and more than 90% accuracy when summarizing complex databases.

Q2 revenue was $93.3 million, software revenue $48.8 million and software bookings $50.7 million, up 9%. Adjusted EBITDA was $26.2 million. Full-year continuing-operations revenue guidance is $367 million-$382 million with adjusted EBITDA margin of 29%-31%.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $93.3M; software $48.8M; bookings $50.7M (+9%); EBITDA $26.2M; FY revenue $367M-$382M
